action_items: Add 'Vérifier la compatibilité' button on ProductDetailPage that opens a modal where user enters plate XX-123-XX and gets compatibility feedback. This was explicitly requested in item 10 of the user's problem statement.
(Optional) Surface inline error message when user enters invalid plate format in SearchHero Plaque tab (e.g. red text under the input).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1700+ lines with offers/bank-info/view-counter added - URGENTLY split into modules (auth, products, orders, offers, files, auctions, chat, admin).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with credentials=True remains invalid per CORS spec.

POST /api/products/{id}/view duplicates the view increment that GET /api/products/{id} already performs (line 555). Result: opening the product page then calling /view causes double counting. Consider removing the increment from GET or documenting the intent.

/api/bank-info exposes raw env values with no auth - consider requiring auth or at least returning empty strings when user is not authenticated (currently returns IBAN/BIC to anyone who hits the endpoint).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all pages render, dark theme product page, admin offers, homepage redesign, footer all correct; missing only 'Vérifier la compatibilité' button)
